tools.name: check_freightbox_capability
tools.description: Whether Freightbox supports a given capability: supported, partial, or not_supported, with a short explanation. Covers what it deliberately does not do, including autonomous sending, TMS functions, and standalone shipment tracking.

capability.description: The capability in question, e.g. 'send emails automatically' or 'track shipments'

tools.name: get_demo_booking_options
tools.description: Links a person can use to start a Freightbox trial or contact the team. Returns links only; it does not book, sign up, or send anything.

tools.name: get_freightbox_overview
tools.description: A JSON object describing Freightbox: product name, a one-paragraph summary, release stage, a bulleted list of situations it is built for (whenToUse), a bulleted list of situations it is not built for (whenNotToUse), its human-review principle, and a link to the full guide.

tools.name: get_freightbox_pricing
tools.description: Freightbox plans, prices, limits, and trial terms as structured data, optionally for a single plan (starter, business, enterprise).

plan.description: Optional plan id: starter, business, or enterprise

tools.name: list_freightbox_integrations
tools.description: The email providers Freightbox connects to and the ways an agent or developer can access it: MCP server, public documentation MCP, Platform API, and webhooks.

type.description: Optional filter: email_provider, agent_access, developer, or optional

tools.name: list_freightbox_pages
tools.description: Every page of the Freightbox website with its path, section, and a one-line summary, plus which page is currently open and which other pages share its section.

section.description: Optional filter: overview, product, developers, company, or legal

tools.name: navigate_freightbox_site
tools.description: Opens an allow-listed page of the Freightbox website in the current tab. Changes what the person is looking at; reversible with the browser Back button.

page.description: One of: home, features, pricing, security, developers, faq, about, contact, changelog, privacy, terms

tools.name: read_freightbox_page
tools.description: The readable text of the Freightbox website page currently open in this tab, with its title, path, and section.

maxCharacters.description: Truncate the returned text at this length (default 12000)

tools.name: search_freightbox_docs
tools.description: Sections of Freightbox's published documentation matching a query, covering features, security, integrations, and how the product works.

query.description: What to look up, e.g. 'how are drafts reviewed'
